_readme: Hand-labelled expected output, transcribed by reading the invoice images.
This is the only source of real accuracy in the project; the invoice-total
checksum is a proxy that cannot see wrong names or missing REFCODEs.
'prix' is always the LINE TOTAL: what this row cost in full, before any
reimbursement split. Note that the column holding it is NOT identified by
its label - see the note on each entry.
Add entries with: pharmacy-ocr label <invoice>  (renders the page, then
you type the rows). Keys are the invoice filename stem.

invoice1.note: Phone photo, page rotated 90 degrees, held by hand over a desk. Columns: Code PCT|Produit|Forme|Qte|PUV|Mt. Percu|N.I.O|PR/Lot. Line total is 'Mt. Percu'. First REFCODE is a 14-digit barcode-style code, not the usual 6 digits.

invoice2.note: Phone photo, page UPSIDE DOWN (180 degrees), faint toner. Columns: Code PCT|Articles|Qte|Prix Ht|Tva|Total. A 180-degree page keeps normal box shapes, so the tall-box rotation test cannot see it.

BCEB1sm024Qw0iywNadPLd6irBEGy1VfIXi5Evq1.note: Columns: PCT|Nom de specialite|Qte|Prix Pub|Tot. Fact|T.Ref|Tx|Percu. Line total is 'Tot. Fact'; 'Percu' is the patient copay. Scan also contains an unrelated radiology receipt below the invoice, which must be ignored.

vyTFMJlyMb0u9wDolfj0Y1Zs0Lz4CPbQkb04xqjR.note: Page rotated 90 degrees. Columns: Code PCT|Produit|Forme|Qte|PUV|Mt. Percu|N.I.O|PR/Lot. Here the line total IS 'Mt. Percu' (row 4: Qte 2 x PUV 23.350 = 46.700), the opposite of BCEB1sm. Only the column whose sum matches the printed total identifies itself.

29StqnikXLGhYWvlhlNqrIjH6YMjmMhyHvRyjOkW.note: Page rotated 90 degrees. Columns: Code PCT|Produit|Forme|Qte|PUV|Mt. Percu|N.I.O|PR/Lot. Single row.

2Bm1FOWEBBoP3AazTHAbZ01wZn8hrXHE3PHQgVZP.note: No header row at all; free-form 'CODE NAME  Qte x unit = total' layout. REFCODE 000000 is the pharmacy's own placeholder for uncoded products and IS printed, so it is not null.

4EhVxBo24tQzVPKFsDR8UvR8KoDE5Iv6xEWEXNyI.note: Columns: Code|Libelle|Qte|Prix U.|Total. A product package leaflet is photographed beside the invoice; its prose must not become items.
